critical_findings: The free stack does not yield one effective-dated security master joining issuer, security class, ticker aliases, membership, and exits.

allowed_reuse: Use SEC CIK as an issuer anchor, not as a security-class identifier.
Use OpenFIGI only after an effective-dated issuer/security mapping is independently established.

next_safe_route: Wait for WRDS/CRSP or another licensed point-in-time security master; meanwhile run only prospective shadow collection from 2026-09-19 onward. Do not backfill 756 dates from these free sources.
